description:
A fantastic opportunity to acquire a turnkey five-bedroom family home, ideally located within walking distance of Killarney town centre and the renowned Killarney House & Gardens.
This well-maintained residence is situated in a highly sought-after, quiet and mature residential area, enjoying an attractive outlook over the green area. The property offers generous and versatile accommodation throughout, making it an ideal choice for families seeking a spacious home in an established and convenient location.
On the ground floor, the accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, sitting room, and a spacious living room with access from both the hall and kitchen. The bright, south-facing kitchen/dining room overlooks the private, cobbled rear garden and provides an excellent space for everyday family living and entertaining. There is also a utility room, a bedroom, and a Jack & Jill shower room completing the ground-floor accommodation.
Upstairs, there are four further bedrooms, including a master bedroom with en-suite, together with a main family bathroom.
To the rear, the well-laid-out garden provides a private outdoor space, while a substantial cavity-built shed offers excellent potential for conversion into a home office, gym, studio or additional recreational space.
With its generous living accommodation, excellent location and established surroundings, this property presents an excellent opportunity for new homeowners to settle into a mature residential area within easy reach of Killarney town centre and its many amenities.
Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this wonderful family home has to offer.
